name: Cross
description: Ball played from wide areas into the box.

name: Head pass
description: Pass made with a player’s head.

name: Through ball
description: Ball played through for an attacking run.

name: Players caught offside
description: Player in offside position when pass was made.

name: Unknown / not mapped
description: No mapping found in the public reference used for this build.

name: Last line
description: Defensive action by the last defender.

name: Involved
description: Players in starting lineup and available substitutes.

name: Related event ID
description: Related event such as an assist event.

name: 1 on 1
description: Attacker clear with no defenders between attacker and goalkeeper.

name: Goal mouth Y co-ordinate
description: Y coordinate where shot crossed goal line.

name: Goal mouth Z co-ordinate
description: Height coordinate where shot crossed goal line.

name: Swerve Right
description: Shot swerves right from attacker perspective.

name: Direction of play
value_format: Right to Left / Left to Right
description: Actual direction relative to TV camera; coordinates normalized left-to-right.

name: Keeper Touched
description: Goal where goalkeeper got a touch.

name: Pass End X
description: X pitch coordinate for end point of pass.

name: Pass End Y
description: Y pitch coordinate for end point of pass.

name: Deleted event type
description: ID of event that should be removed.

name: Formation slot
description: Formation position of player coming on.

name: Blocked X co-ordinate
description: X pitch coordinate where shot was blocked.

name: Blocked Y co-ordinate
description: Y pitch coordinate where shot was blocked.

name: Not past goal line
description: Shot missed but did not pass goal line.

name: Lay-off
description: Player lays ball into teammate run.

name: Launch
description: Pass from own half toward front players, aimed at a zone.

name: Throw-in set piece
description: Shot came from throw-in set piece.

name: Out of play
description: Tackle/clearance sent ball out of play.

name: Flick-on
description: Player flicked ball forward using head.

name: Leading to attempt
description: Player error leading to opponent shot.

name: Hands
description: Keeper save with hands; reference says replaced by 267-272.

name: Feet
description: Keeper save with feet; reference says replaced by 267-272.

name: Player not visible
description: Replay/non-live footage; analyst believes event occurred.

name: Switch of play
description: Pass crosses centre zone and exceeds specified length threshold.

name: GK hoof
description: Keeper drops ball and kicks it long toward a position.

name: Assist
description: Pass was an assist for a shot.

name: Overrun
description: Take-on where ball runs away to opponent/out.

name: Angle
description: Angle of ball travel relative to direction of play.

name: Individual Play
description: Player created chance to shoot alone.

name: 2nd related event ID
description: Related event ID for second assist.

name: 2nd assisted
description: Significant pass creating opportunity for assist.

name: GK X Coordinate
description: Keeper X position when goal/shot hit post.

name: GK Y Coordinate
description: Keeper Y position when goal/shot hit post.

name: Opposite related event ID
description: Links corresponding events for both teams.

name: Blocked Pass
description: Pass blocked by nearby defender; distinct from interception.

name: Minutes
description: Minutes of injury time given by referee.

name: Kick Off
description: Starting pass; used to exclude kickoff from passing percentage.
